core_obligations: Replace normality by the conjunction of (S_2) and (R_1) (proof lines 10564-10566).
Apply ascent of the two conditions along the regular map (proof lines 10567-10569).
Conclude normality of the target (proof lines 10569-10570).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a Noetherian target of a regular ring map from a normal Noetherian ring is again normal. The proof uses the criterion that for Noetherian rings normality is equivalent to the conjunction of the two conditions (S_2) and (R_1), and then applies the two corresponding ascent statements for those conditions along a regular map, obtaining both for the target and hence normality.
